title: Use CC BY-NC license
description:
The CC-BY-NC that means anyone can use, but:

* they have to cite us as the original source,
* they cannot charge money for it without our permission (which we can grant on a case by case basis). It does allow them to creative derivative works (e.g., reformat it or add their own exercises), but does not require them to distribute their own changes under any particular license (i.e., it's not infective like the GPL).

title: Refactor short documents into sections
description:
In a previous incarnation of the course we could only create shortcuts to individual documents.  With `mkdocs` we can shortcut to headers in a document.

This means we can combine short documents into a single document.  For example, collapse the 4 overview documents into a single `overview.md`
